subject: dec
title: (R)DEC.------DYM.F.
description: Chart on book p. 422 (MID-W-16). DEC (decentralization) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: INFO-CON (information convergence). From INFO-CON: LK-IMP (linkage implications) and MTA-RT-SIGN (meta-reality significance). From MTA-RT-SIGN: DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism). From DYM-SPT: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From PROG-CONT: TR (transformation).
